entries.zh: 亡灵显形、鬼魂显灵（顯神/玄神：死者之灵现身）
entries.en: for the dead to appear, the spirit of the deceased to manifest itself
entries.notes: H 栏玄/顯存疑[疑:玄/顯]，取「显神（神灵显形）」义更贴合 aparecerse el muerto；L 栏尾语 estalsa dotrina 待考。

entries.zh: 化身显灵、奇迹般地现身显圣
entries.en: to appear miraculously, manifest oneself in bodily form

entries.zh: 备筵、置办整治筵席（aparejar：备办、整理；参见 messa la「设桌」条）
entries.en: to prepare, i.e. to compose, dress and set out (a banquet); see messa la
entries.notes: L 栏缩写 vt（疑为 véase「参见」）展开依赖推断；M 栏多音节串超出单字头，未强解。

entries.zh: 备具、置备器具（为……备办齐全）
entries.en: to outfit them, to get the gear/implements ready (for ...)
entries.notes: L 栏 mechos 词义不明（疑为 machos「骡马」讹写，则指备鞍辔用具），据 H 栏「具」取备具义。

entries.zh: 备办齐全、置备周全（为宴席备齐所需）
entries.en: to make fully ready, provide what is needed (for the feast)
entries.notes: H 栏备/倍存疑[疑:備/倍]。

entries.zh: 排列、摆放、布置整齐
entries.en: to arrange, put in order

entries.zh: 排宴、设宴备席
entries.en: to prepare, set out a banquet

entries.zh: 排列平整、疏密均匀（布置得匀称）
entries.en: to arrange evenly: level, with even spacing (dense and sparse alike)
entries.notes: H 栏疏/踈存疑[疑:疏/踈]；L 栏 si este ygual 疑为 assí esté igual（使之均匀）之讹。

entries.zh: 辨（同「办」）：置办、筹备
entries.en: to prepare, provide, manage (辨 = 辦, to make ready)

entries.zh: 备茶、沏茶待客
entries.en: to prepare the tea

entries.zh: 置办停当、备办就绪（把所需备齐）
entries.en: to get ready whatever is needed, make all convenient

entries.zh: 备而未齐、尚未置办妥当（辨未便）
entries.en: prepared, though not yet fully ready

entries.zh: 设、设置、陈设
entries.en: to set up, arrange, lay out

entries.zh: 设席、铺席摆酒（设桌备宴）
entries.en: to set the table, spread a feast

entries.zh: 设桌、摆桌设宴（即邀客、请客）
entries.en: to set the table or prepare a feast, i.e. to invite guests (convidar)

entries.zh: 备：预备、备好、齐备
entries.en: to prepare, get ready; ready, prepared
entries.notes: H 栏备/倍存疑[疑:備/倍]。

entries.zh: 备办、置备（无论何物皆可置备）
entries.en: to prepare, make ready (any thing whatsoever)
entries.notes: H 栏备/倍存疑[疑:備/倍]；L 栏缩写 ç. 展开依赖推断。

entries.zh: 料理妥当、收拾停当（使就便）
entries.en: to prepare and dress it up, make things convenient

entries.zh: 便益：便利受益、有好处；备妥而得利
entries.en: convenience and profit; to be ready and of benefit, advantageous

entries.zh: 遇便：碰巧得便、恰遇便利（未经思量而凑巧就绪）
entries.en: ready by chance, convenient without premeditation; to meet with a convenient occasion

entries.zh: 安排酒桌、摆桌备宴
entries.en: to arrange a table and prepare the feast

entries.zh: 摆酒、操办酒席（婚宴喜庆）
entries.en: to prepare the wine-feast (wedding banquet)
entries.notes: R 栏「酒」音节污损难辨（T99），按规程降为 low；释义据 L/H/M 三栏仍明确。
